data.version: Original392005 source contract; existing R07 fixed1800 V/7 frozen validation views
data.representation: Source V480 fixed R07 25MHz 2462MHz residual, six practical scenes. Same propagation, noise seed, clean and physical IDs; original validation hardware, training hardware at same RX/day, or one-step circular reassignment of validation hardware across ordered RX/day. permissions.query_use: No target, OE or novel data; no adaptation or fitting. No Main hardware, profile or seed used.
permissions.claim_scope: Only sensitivity to selected source synthetic hardware in the same fixed simulated propagation. No hardware receiver shift, new deployment candidate or Main performance claim.

metric_names: Paired TX repairs/damage, IQ NMSE, and received vs restoration.

rows.purpose: Test sensitivity to source RX profiles independently of packet and propagation.

notes: Profiles assigned without TX or label use. The rotation preserves the profile multiset with 32 records per group.
